propositions: docs/llm-framework.md must document the exact runtime contract for repository-owned code-review criteria flowing through fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval resolution, and CLI admission
Repository-effective project LLM criteria are injected exactly once into round_a and never injected into round_b, whose membership remains controlled by bounded escalation/overlay selection
Project code-review ids must resolve through the criteria eval arm with unambiguous single-gate membership; unknown or cross-gate-ambiguous ids are rejected before calibration
A project criterion with missing or invalid prompt/eval specification must raise a located configuration error rather than silently falling back

The documentation section must include four subheadings (Round A/B fan-in, Effective routing in Pass 3, criteria eval resolution, Configuration error) with required semantic markers in the section body
